# 608 - Qbar_BECD FIdx24 Probe Obstruction Terminal Basin Boundary Killfrontier Facet Route Edge Typed Source Event Classifier Contract Spec

## Status

Construction-spec refinement anchor. Layer I only; this is not an RH result.

## Pinch

Doc 607 kills the attempt to preserve the exact doc-606 substring-priority
decisions under a finite source-native typed token grammar. The failure is not
the 106-surface inventory or the doc-602 anchor composition; it is the evidence
shape. In particular, the hard winner for the missing terminal-basin
certificate only sees `action` as a substring inside `contraction`.

Doc 608 rebuilds the same route-edge classification from typed source events:
namespace, obstruction-tail, exact tail, or one named event kind. This keeps the
106 surface decisions and doc-602 anchor composition while forbidding doc-606
substring evidence from re-entering through a token grammar.

## Required Object

The new live object is:

```text
_ObstructionTerminalBasinBoundaryKillfrontierFacetRouteEdgeTypedSourceEventClassifierReflectedFixedpointTraceExecutableGlobalContraction_source_square
```

This object strengthens doc 606 by adding seven acceptance clauses:

1. The doc-606 priority layer remains the base, but not its substring evidence.
2. Every one of the 106 boundary surfaces has a typed source event.
3. The classifier uses only namespace, obstruction-tail, exact-tail, or named
   event-kind evidence.
4. The rule system has 70 rule literals, strictly fewer than the 106 surfaces,
   so it is not a row-for-row lookup table.
5. The resulting classes preserve the doc-602 anchor composition on every
   boundary surface.
6. The doc-607 hard failure is resolved by the event kind
   `missing_terminal_basin_certificate`, not by matching `action` inside
   `contraction`.
7. The classifier is finite, source-internal, deterministic, extensional,
   proof-relevant, dependency-closed, graph-wired, replay-stable, and budgeted.

## Fail-Closed Exclusions

Missing or partial typed source-event classifiers, missing event kind,
namespace, or tail data, rule/evidence/anchor mismatches, substring-token
evidence, preserved doc-606 substring evidence, unresolved doc-607 hard or
shadow failures, nonminimal, infinite, non-source-internal, nondeterministic,
nonextensional, dependency-open, graph-unwired, replay-unstable,
proof-irrelevant, external, oracle-backed, branch-spawning, unbounded, retuned,
new-cell, context-collapse, declaration-only, finite-sample, basis-row, or
unbudgeted typed classifiers are diagnostics only.
